jsonld_raw.name: (180 G) CLEAN BLOSSOM SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle. Contains vegetable waxes.

Clean Blossom | A luminous floral bouquet enhanced by a sophisticated woody signature. A cheerful scent where three precious white flowers celebrate their faceted beauty. An enveloping jasmine heart glows with the vibrant citrus tones of orange blossom and the sensual exoticism of vanilla flower.

Olfactory notes:
Top: PETIT GRAIN, mandarin, pine cone, bergamot.
Heart: orange blossom, spicata lavender, jasmine, vanilla flower.
Base: vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, ambrox.
